properties.name: Every release brings reflow2's site (flo2-connector.github.io/reflow2) up to date with what it ships, and a release that leaves it behind fails the build
properties.statement:
Each reflow2 release shall bring the public site up to date with what that release ships: what it explains, the setup steps it gives, and the version it says it describes. A release whose site still describes an older reflow2 shall fail the build rather than wait for a reader to notice. The release cut (flow:release-cut) carries this as a step, beside assembling the CHANGELOG.

Anthony, 2026-10-09, during the v0.81.0 cut: "make sure to update flo2-connector.github.io/reflow2 documentation appropriately /req". Measured 2026-10-09: the nine steps of flow:release-cut named no site step, and no check read the site.
